name: Restricted Proof Candidate Phase Declaration
purpose: Declare the proof-candidate review phase and freeze admissible proof language before theorem-specific work begins.

phase_definition.canonical_statement: The restricted proof candidate review phase permits the formal evaluation of local theorem candidates (MT-001, MT-002, MT-003) under strict non-physical analog governance and explicit assumption declaration.
phase_definition.non_escalation_rule: Review status does not constitute proof. No candidate may be promoted to 'PROVEN' status during this phase.

governance_rules.rule: Every proof candidate must explicitly declare all assumptions and restricted domain bounds.
No proof candidate review may erase or hide active counterexamples.
Local theorem derivation does not imply truth or ontology identity.
All mathematical failures encountered during review must be preserved as structural information.

forbidden_claims: A supported candidate is a proven theorem.
Local derivation readiness implies physical relevance.
Theorem success proves global framework closure.
